params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: id
params.description: Comma-separated list of requested Group Connection Request UUIDs

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the group connection for which you would like to filter. Multiple statuses can be used, separated by a comma.

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Comma-separated list of carrier UUID's for which you would like to view group connection requests

params.name: carrier_group_id
params.description: Used for filtering for a carrier-specific group ID. Must be used with a single carrier_id

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization for which you would like to view group connection requests

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The attribute on which to sort the group connections

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Either asc or desc, to denote the data's direction

params.name: requires_mapping_action_from
params.description: The actor type that requires a mapping action from
